multilanguage.author: Ruben Zantingh
multilanguage.policy: Existing IDs and nonempty fields win. Both-language opening match and unflagged bilingual dialogue only; seven reviewed DE opening fills. No source-only IDs or Retail records.
multilanguage.normalization: Decode HTML; normalize paragraphs, NBSP/narrow NBSP and scalar name/class/race placeholders; preserve emotes and gender alternatives. Compare equivalent $gMale:Female; and <Male/Female> without rewriting displayed alternatives.
